title: Cave Blasters
description: Adds naturally generated explosive veins underground.
body:
![A gif showing an example explosion of the explosive vein.](https://i.imgur.com/sEPwWCH.gif)

Features

Explosive Veins: Find explosive stone and deepslate veins underground. Mining them triggers a chain reaction explosion.



Tunnel Generation: The explosions carve natural pathways, shortcuts, and bridges between caves.



Custom Assets: Includes custom animated glowing textures and sound effects.



Configurable: You can easily change the spawn rates in the config file.

v1.0 Note

This is the first release. Core mechanics and chain reactions work perfectly, but the vein placement/generation algorithm is still being improved.
